question: Where in the 2025 Public Accounts can I find Canada’s audited consolidated financial statements?
generated_answer:
The audited consolidated financial statements for Canada are included in the 2025 Public Accounts, specifically in Volume 1, Section 3, starting on page 12. The statements include the Consolidated Statement of Financial Position, the Consolidated Statement of Operations, and the Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows. These statements provide a comprehensive overview of the Government of Canada’s financial position and performance for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2025. The audit report by the Auditor General of Canada is also included in this section, providing assurance on the fairness and reliability of the financial statements. 

To access the 2025 Public Accounts, you can visit the Government of Canada’s official website, specifically the Department of Finance Canada page, or the Library of Parliament’s website, which often hosts historical and current public accounts documents. The Public Accounts are also available in print and digital formats through various government publications and online repositories. 

If you need more detailed information or have specific questions about the financial statements, you may also want to consult the accompanying notes to the financial statements, which provide additional explanations and disclosures about the Government’s accounting policies, significant transactions, and other relevant information. 

Please note that while the 2025 Public Accounts are the most recent available at the time of this response, future audited financial statements will be released annually, typically in the spring of each year, and will be available through similar channels. 

For any further inquiries or if you require assistance in interpreting the financial statements, you may want to contact the Department of Finance Canada or the Office of the Auditor General of Canada directly. 

I hope this information helps you locate and understand the audited consolidated financial statements for Canada in the 2025 Public Accounts.
